sanskrit: ud ihy ud ihi sūrya varcasā mābhy ud ihi | dviṣaṃś ca mahyaṃ radhyatu mā cāhaṃ dviṣate radhaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: Rise up, rise up, O Sun; rise up shining your brilliance upon me. May my foe be subject to me, and may I never be subject to my foe. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: ud ihy ud ihi sūrya varcasā mābhy ud ihi | yāṃś ca paśyāmi yāṃś ca na teṣu me sumatiṃ kṛdhi taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: Rise up, rise up, O Sun; rise up shining your brilliance upon me. Both those whom I see and those whom I do not see — among them make good will toward me. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: mā tvā dabhan salile apsv antar ye pāśina upatiṣṭanty atra | hitvāśastiṃ divam ārukṣa etāṃ sa no mṛḍa sumatau te syāma taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ prīṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: Let not those who lie in wait with snares in the water, amid the waters, deceive you. Abandoning ill-speaking, ascend this sky. Be gracious to us; may we dwell in your favor. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: tvaṃ na indra mahate saubhagāya- -adabdaiḥ pari pāhy aktubhis taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: You, O Indra, guard us for great good fortune with your undeceived rays of light. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: tvaṃ na indrotibhiḥ śivābhiḥ śaṃtamo bhava | ārohan tridivaṃ divo gṛṇānaḥ somapītaye priyadhāmā svastaye taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: Be most soothing to us, O Indra, with your auspicious aids. Ascending to the triple sky, praised for the drinking of soma, beloved of the abode, for our well-being. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: tvam indrāsi viśvavit sarvavit pūruhūtas tvam indremaṃ suhava stomam erayasva | śivābhis tanūbhir abhi naḥ sacasva taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: You, O Indra, are the all-knower, the omniscient, invoked by many. You, O Indra, set in motion this hymn of praise that calls you well. Accompany us with your auspicious bodies. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: adabdho divi pṛthivyām utāsi na ta āpur mahimānam antarikṣe | adabdhena brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānaḥ sa tvaṃ na indra divi ṣaṃ śarma yaccha taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: Undeceived, you exist in heaven and on earth; none have equaled your greatness in the atmosphere. Grown strong through undeceived sacred power, you, O Indra — bestow upon us shelter in heaven. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: yā ta indra tanūr apsv antar yāntar agnau yā pṛthivyāṃ yā ta indra pavamāne svarvidaḥ | yayendra tanvāntarikṣaṃ samāpitha tayā ta indra tanvā saṃ śiśādhi taved (…) ||
english: That body of yours, O Indra, which is within the waters, which is within fire, which is in the earth, that body of yours, O Indra, of the purifying one, the finder of heaven — with which body, O Indra, you have filled the atmosphere: sharpen us with that body of yours, O Indra. [The refrain continues as above.]

sanskrit: tvām indra brahmaṇā vardhayantaḥ satraṃ niṣedur ṛṣayo nādhamānās taved (…) ||
english: The seers, magnifying you, O Indra, with sacred utterance, sat together in session imploring you. [The refrain continues as above.]

sanskrit: tvaṃ rakṣase pratiśaś catasras tvaṃ śociṣā nabhasī vi bhāsi | ṛtasya panthām anv eṣi vidvāṃs tvam imā viśvā bhuvanābhi tiṣṭhasi taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: You guard the four quarters; with your flame you shine through both worlds of the sky. Knowing, you follow the path of cosmic order; you stand over all these worlds. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: saptabhiḥ parāṅ tapasy ekayārvāṅ aśastim eṣi sudine bādhamānaḥ | tvaṃ tṛtaṃ tvaṃ pary eṣvitsaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vitathaṃ svarvidaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: With seven rays you burn away what is beyond; with one ray you drive away ill-speaking downward, repelling it on an auspicious day. You are Tṛta; you are the all-pervading one with a thousand streams, the truly mighty, the finder of heaven. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: tvam indras tvaṃ mahendraṃs tvaṃ viṣṇus tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ | tubhyaṃ yajño vi tāyate tubhyaṃ juhvati juhvatas taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: You are Indra; you are the great Indra; you are Viṣṇu; you are Prajāpati. For you the sacrifice is spread out; those who offer oblations offer them for you. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: asati sat pratiṣṭhitaṃ sati bhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | bhūtaṃ ha bhavya āhitaṃ bhavyaṃ bhūte samāhitaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryāṇi | tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhir viśvarūpaiḥ svadhāyaṃ no dhehi parame vyoman ||
english: Being is established in non-being; the past is established in being. The past is indeed placed in the future; the future is gathered into the past. Such, O Viṣṇu, are your manifold heroic deeds. Enrich us with cattle of all forms; place our ancestral portion in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: śukro 'si bhrājo 'si | sa yathā tvaṃ bhrājato bhrājo 'sy evāhaṃ bhrājato bhrājyāsam ||
english: You are the bright one; you are the shining one. Just as you, shining, are the shining one, so may I too shine with shining brilliance.

sanskrit: rucir asi roco 'si | sa yathā tvaṃ rucyā roco 'sy evāhaṃ prajayā paśubhir brāhmaṇavarcasena rociṣīya ||
english: You are radiance; you are splendor. Just as you are splendor through your radiance, so may I shine with offspring, with cattle, and with the luster of sacred knowledge.

sanskrit: udyate nama udāyate nama uditāya namaḥ | virāje namaḥ svarāje namaḥ samrāje namaḥ ||
english: Homage to the one rising; homage to the one who has risen up; homage to the one who has risen. Homage to the far-ruling one; homage to the self-ruling one; homage to the universal sovereign.

sanskrit: astaṃyate namo 'stameṣyate namo 'stamitāya namaḥ | virāje namaḥ svarāje namaḥ samrāje namaḥ ||
english: Homage to the one setting; homage to the one about to set; homage to the one who has set. Homage to the far-ruling one; homage to the self-ruling one; homage to the universal sovereign.

sanskrit: āditya nāvam ārukṣaṃ śatāritrāṃ svastaye | ahar no adya pīparad rātrī satrāti pārayāt ||
english: I have boarded the hundred-oared ship of Āditya for well-being. May the day nourish us today; may the night carry us safely across unharmed.

sanskrit: sūrya nāvam ārukṣaṃ śatāritrāṃ svastaye | rātrī no adya pīparad ahaḥ satrāti pārayāt ||
english: I have boarded the hundred-oared ship of the Sun for well-being. May the night nourish us today; may the day carry us safely across unharmed.

sanskrit: prajāpater āvṛto brahmaṇā varmaṇāhaṃ kaśyapasya jyotiṣā varcasā ca | jaradaṣṭiḥ kṛtavīryo vihāyāḥ sahasrāyuḥ sukṛtaś careyam ||
english: Wrapped in the armor of sacred utterance belonging to Prajāpati, and in the light and luster of Kaśyapa, may I walk as one who lives to old age, who has performed heroic deeds, who traverses the sky, who has a thousand lives, who has done good.

sanskrit: ṛtena gupta ṛtubhiś ca sarvair bhūtena gupta uta bhavyena cāham | mā mā prāpann iṣavo daivyā yā mā mānuṣīr avasṛṣṭā vadhāya ||
english: Protected by cosmic order and by all the seasons, protected by the past and by the future — may the divine arrows not reach me, nor the human arrows released to strike me down.

sanskrit: parivṛto brahmaṇā varmaṇāhaṃ kaśyapasya jyotiṣā varcasā ca | mā mā prāpat pāpmā mota mṛtyur antar dadhe salilena vācaḥ ||
english: Encircled by the armor of sacred utterance, and by the light and luster of Kaśyapa, may evil not reach me, nor death. I have hidden myself inwardly with the flood of sacred speech.

sanskrit: agnir mā gopāḥ pari pātu viśvato vyucchantīr uṣasaḥ parvatā dhruvā | udyan sūryo nudatāṃ mṛtyupāśān sahasraṃ prāṇā mayi te ramantām ||
english: May Agni as my guardian protect me on all sides; may the Dawns that blaze forth and the firm mountains protect me. May the rising Sun drive away the snares of death; may your thousand life-breaths take delight in me.

sanskrit: o cit sakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ purū cid arṇavaṃ jaganvān | pitur napātam ā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ ||
english: I would turn the friend toward friendship, even having crossed many a flood. The wise one should lay hold of the grandson of the Father, reflecting upon the further shore of earth.

sanskrit: na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭy etat salakṣmā yad viṣurūpā bhavāti | sahas putrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan ||
english: Your friend does not desire this friendship, since she who is of the same mark becomes of diverse forms. The mighty sons of Asura, heroes, sustainers of the sky, have looked about on every side from far.

sanskrit: uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etad ekasya cit tyajasaṃ martyasya | ni te mano manasi dhāyy asme janyuḥ patis tanvam ā viviśyāḥ ||
english: The immortals truly desire this — even the utter abandonment of a single mortal. Your mind has been set in our mind; enter the body, O husband, as the lord of the clan.

sanskrit: na yat purā cakṛmā kad dha nūnam ṛtaṃ vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema | gandharvo apsv apyā ca yoṣā sā no nābhiḥ paramaṃ jātaman nau ||
english: What we did not do before — why should we speak falsehood now while speaking truth? The Gandharva in the waters and the watery maiden — she is our navel, the highest, the birth-origin of us two.

sanskrit: garbhe nū nau janitā dampatī kar devas tvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ | nakir asya pra minanti vratāni veda nāv asya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
english: In the womb the divine Tvaṣṭṛ, the all-formed Savitṛ, has now made us two a couple. None violate his ordinances; earth and sky know his design concerning us two.

sanskrit: ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhaṇāyūn | āsanniṣūn hṛtasvaso mayobhūn ya eṣāṃ bhṛtyām ṛṇadhat sa jīvāt ||
english: Who today harnesses to the pole the cows of cosmic order — the vigorous, passionate, fiercely hostile ones, with arrows ready, whose breath has been seized, yet who are beneficent? He who releases them from their servitude — may he live.

sanskrit: ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat | bṛhan mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kad u brava āhano vīcyā nṝn ||
english: Who knows of this first day? Who has seen it? Who here has proclaimed it? Great is the abode of Mitra and Varuṇa. What shall the day-striker say, summoning men with its voice?

sanskrit: yamasya mā yamyaṃ kāma āgan samāne yonau sahaśeyyāya | jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cid vṛheva rathyeva cakrā ||
english: The desire of Yamī has come to me, Yama, for lying together in the same womb. Like a wife for a husband, I would offer my body; let us join like the wheel-spokes of a chariot spreading apart.

sanskrit: na tiṣṭhati na ni miṣanty ete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti | anyena mad āhano yāhi bhūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā ||
english: These spies of the gods who wander here do not stand still nor do they close their eyes. Go, O day-striker, be with another instead of me; spread wide with that one like the wheel-spokes of a chariot.

sanskrit: rātrībhir asmā ahabhir daśasyet sūryasya cakṣur muhur un mimīyāt | divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīr yamasya vivṛhed ajāmi ||
english: One should honor him with nights and days; the eye of the Sun should be lifted up again and again. The two who are akin, kindred as the couple of sky and earth — may Yamī uncover the non-kinship of Yama.
